ref.quote: Ondersteuning zorgpersoneel / Soutien du personnel soignant ... Bijdragen aan publieke ziekenhuizen ... Bijdragen aan privé ziekenhuizen ... Subsidie ziekenwagendiensten / Subsides aide médicale urgente ... Dotatie aan het FAVV / Dotation à l'AFSCA
ref.note: Mixed line. The care-staff programme also covers 'Stortingen Fonds Maribel' and 'Ondersteuning sector zelfstandige verpleging / Soutien au secteur des infirmiers indépendants' (p. 858). Food-safety phrase: the FAVV dotation funds the agency, whose own 2026 budget (same document pp. 466-468) lists 'Aankoop van monsters en staalnamemateriaal', 'controle-uitrusting voor controle en labo's' and 'Routineanalyses'; the FAVV is also funded by levies and fees. favv-afsca.be returned a CAPTCHA, so the agency site was not used. Also in the line, not phrased: Sciensano, FAGG/AFMPS (medicines agency), animal-health fund (compensation for slaughtered animals), COVID vaccines, environment. Health insurance (RIZIV/INAMI) is a separate line. confirmed: FAVV/AFSCA phrase (flag 2) holds: the dotation (p. 864, justification p. 121) funds the agency, whose own 2026 budget in the same document lists staff (pp. 461-463), 'Aankoop van monsters en staalnamemateriaal', 'controle-uitrusting voor controle en labo's' and 'Routineanalyses' with external labs (pp. 466-468). It is only part of the agency's income (fees such as 'Controlerechten' and 'Hercontroles', p. 488), as the caveat says. Locator widened to pp. 121 and 461-468; ambulance and care-staff allocations confirmed on pp. 858 and 862.
